name: Escape from Dr. Crab!
author: ToastBubbles
description: Doctor Crab has unleashed a bunch of evil robot crabs that are wreaking havoc on all our friends! Can you collect the 4 parts needed to build the laser and stop Dr. Crab? (Made using only Behavior Bricks, all images/extra models were made by me, the song in the trailer is royalty free from Soundly).
